Card Q&A.q: I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. If they block it with one of their Digimon, does this card's effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] When this Digimon attacks a player, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
